content.short: Plume is a modular Layer 1 blockchain purpose-built for RWAfi, featuring a native tokenization engine.
content.description:
Plume Network is a pioneering modular Layer 1 blockchain specifically engineered to facilitate the seamless onboarding and trading of all real-world assets (RWAs). The platform features a built-in tokenization engine called Arc, which handles institutional-grade compliance, identity verification, and AML monitoring directly at the protocol level. This approach eliminates the complex logistical barriers typically associated with moving traditional physical assets on-chain, enabling a more efficient and transparent RWAfi ecosystem.

By providing a highly scalable and secure environment for decentralized finance, Plume allows developers to launch a wide array of RWA-backed products including real estate, commodities, and credit facilities. The network is powered by the PLUME token, which facilitates transaction fees, staking, and decentralized governance. Through its commitment to regulatory alignment and technical innovation, Plume Network is building the essential infrastructure for the next generation of global finance, where physical stability meets the innovative efficiency of the decentralized web.
content.meta: Plume Network provides modular Layer 1 infrastructure specifically designed for RWA tokenization and finance.
